item.title: Ross Fire grows to one of the largest wildfires on record in North Texas
item.description: A week later, wildfires continue to burn more than 80,000 acres in Palo Pinto and Jack counties. Containment has grown to 31%, according to the Texas A&M Forest Service. No injuries have been reported.
